title: izalotion
description: A plugin that you can use to isolate players.
body: This plugin allows you to assemble all players into one team using the commands: /izalotion add| remove| list | exit. It creates an isolated space in the shape of a circle or square, the dimensions of which you can set yourself. In isolation, players cannot use interaction commands, as well as gems and the fruit of Horus. The appearance and removal of insulation are accompanied by animation.
